RowErrorDTO.description:
A single row-scoped failure. Deliberately mirrors the frontend
`ValidationError` shape so the upload page can render server-detected
problems in exactly the same error matrix as client-side ones.

rowIndex.description: 1-based spreadsheet row number, matching what the user sees in Excel.

BatchStudentUploadRow.description:
A single row of the "Students Master" Excel template.
Columns: studentId, schoolCode, className, academicYear, studentName, isActive

studentName.description: Full name; split server-side into firstName / lastName.

isActive.description: Defaults to `true` when the column is omitted or blank.

Pick_SchoolSummaryDTO.id-or-code-or-name.description: From T, pick a set of properties whose keys are in the union K

ParentInteractionResponseDTO.description: A persisted register entry, as returned by the API.

ParentInteractionUploadResultDTO.description: Result of the bulk upload, matching the shared `BatchUploadResultDTO` shape.

ParentInteractionUploadRequestBody.description:
Route-level body shape for `POST /parent-interactions/upload`.

A plain interface rather than the Zod-inferred type because tsoa cannot
introspect `z.infer`; `parentInteractionUploadSchema` remains the authoritative
runtime gate. Mirrors the `AttendanceUploadRequestBody` precedent.

BatchClassUploadRow.description:
A single row of the "Classes Master" Excel template.
Columns: schoolCode, className, academicYear (plus two optional overrides).

Record_string.unknown_.description: Construct a type with a set of properties K of type T

cancellations.description: Number of class-wide cancellation records created.

sessionsProcessed.description: Number of distinct (class, date) sessions touched.

AttendanceUploadRequestBody.description:
Route-level body shape for `POST /attendance/batch-upload`.

This is deliberately a plain interface rather than the Zod-inferred union:
tsoa must be able to resolve the declared parameter type when generating the
OpenAPI spec and routes, and it cannot introspect
`z.infer<typeof SomeUnionSchema>`. The interface documents both accepted
shapes for the spec, while `AttendanceUploadRequestSchema` remains the
authoritative runtime gate (it strips unknown keys and coerces types).

Both forms are accepted on the one route, discriminated by `classSectionId`:
 - envelope form: `{ schoolId, classSectionId, records: [...] }`
 - code form:     `{ records: [{ schoolCode, className, academicYear, ... }] }`

schoolId.description: Envelope form only: the owning school.

classSectionId.description: Envelope form only. When present, the envelope form is expected.

studentId.description: Envelope form matches on the student's code within the school.

MetricsFilterEchoDTO.description:
Every response embeds the resolved filter window so a client can prove which
period the figures describe - essential when a dashboard caches sections
independently and the user changes a filter mid-session.

value.description: Absolute movement against the comparison period, in the metric's own unit.

percent.description: Percentage movement, where the comparison base is non-zero. `null` when undefined.

comparisonLabel.description: Signed comparison label, e.g. "vs last month" / "vs last year".

value.description:
Numeric value. Kept numeric (not a pre-formatted string) so the card can apply
its own locale/precision rules; the Angular `KpiMetric.value` union already
accepts a number, and `formatTrend` / `unit` cover the presentation.

trend.description: Backwards-compatible pre-formatted trend string, e.g. "+8% vs last year".

increase.description: `current - baseline` in percentage points - the dashboard's "+12%" tile.

DomainProgressDTO.description: One domain's baseline vs current attainment, as a percentage.

baseline.description: Mean stage converted to a 0-100 scale (S1=20 … S5=100).

baselineStudents.description: Number of students with a usable baseline row; 0 means the domain is unreported.

StageMovementItemDTO.description:
Stage *movement* - the same distribution at baseline versus current, plus the
per-stage movement, so the UI can render a slope or a delta bar.

baselinePercentage.description: Distribution at the student's baseline assessment.

currentPercentage.description: Distribution at the student's most recent assessment.

deltaPoints.description: `current - baseline`, in percentage points. Positive = cohort moved up.

SasCategory.description:
SAS (Student Achievement Status) bands.

IMPORTANT - read before changing:
SAS is a *student-level attainment status* computed from the student's own mean
stage across the domains that were actually assessed. It is a measurement.

It is deliberately NOT the same thing as the Support / Anchor / Stretch *Bands*
held in `class_domain_summaries`, which `Docs/Class-summary.md` (section 11)
records as expert-entered planning targets owned by the Head of Department, and
which that document explicitly forbids auto-assigning. Nothing in this module
reads, writes or overwrites those columns.

color.description: Akshara palette colour for the donut segment.

LearningProgressDTO.description:
Aspect 2 - `GET /metrics/learning-outcomes`.

`domainProgress` covers every one of the seven baseline domains
(Vocabulary, Grammar, Phrase_Sentence, Listening, Speaking, Reading, Writing).
The four "core skill" domains the chart card renders - Listening, Speaking,
Reading, Writing - are additionally pre-isolated in `learningProgress` so the
card does not have to filter client-side.

learningProgress.description: The four core-skill domains, in display order.

domainProgress.description: All seven baseline domains, in canonical order.

stageDistribution.description: Stage distribution of students at their *current* stage.

stageMovement.description: Baseline vs current stage distribution, with movement.

sasDistribution.description: SAS (Student Achievement Status) split: Support vs Core vs Stretch.

studentsAssessed.description: Students with at least one usable stage in either period.

MetricsStatusBand.description:
Monitoring & Evaluation (M&E) banding shown per school in the performance matrix.

`CRITICAL` is the canonical value requested by the product spec. It maps to the
display string `'Needs Attention'`, which is what the Angular dashboard already
declares in `SchoolPerformanceItem.meStatus`. Emitting both lets the backend
speak the spec's vocabulary while remaining drop-in compatible with the
existing frontend union, without editing any frontend file.

SchoolPerformanceDTO.description:
Aspect 3 - one row of the school performance matrix.

Field names deliberately mirror the Angular `SchoolPerformanceItem`
(`id`, `school`, `students`, `attendance`, `learningGain`, `objectives`,
`meStatus`) so the existing table component can consume this response with no
adapter. The richer, unambiguous names sit alongside them.

meStatus.description:
`'On Track' | 'Watch' | 'Critical'` - the product spec's vocabulary.

NOTE: the Angular `SchoolPerformanceItem.meStatus` currently declares
`'Needs Attention'` as its third member. `meStatusCategory` below carries the
exact same band under the label the frontend already expects, so the component
keeps type-checking without any frontend edit. When the frontend is next
updated, `'Critical'` can replace `'Needs Attention'` outright.

learningGainPoints.description: Percentage points gained between baseline and current attainment.

riskScore.description: Composite Risk Level Score, 0-100 where higher is healthier.

dataCompletenessPercent.description: Assessment data completeness for this school, as a percentage.

classCount.description: Number of class sections in scope for this school.

NeedsAttentionCategory.description: Alert categories emitted by the dynamic "Needs Attention" generator.

NeedsAttentionDTO.description:
Aspect 4 - one dynamically generated alert.

These are never persisted. Every call re-derives them from the same figures that
feed the KPI tiles, which is what guarantees the alert list can never contradict
the numbers shown beside it.

`title` / `subtitle` additionally reproduce the Angular `NeedsAttentionItem`
shape so the existing list component renders without an adapter.

title.description: Frontend-compatible headline, e.g. "Attendance (Shirdi Sai Baba School)".

subtitle.description: Frontend-compatible supporting line, e.g. "Irregular in some classes".

issueDescription.description: Human-readable explanation of what is wrong.

actionNeeded.description: What a human should actually do about it.

observedValue.description: The measured figure that triggered the alert.

thresholdValue.description: The threshold it was compared against.

gapPoints.description: Percentage points below the programme average, where that is what triggered it.

ObjectiveProgressDTO.description: Aspect 5, tiles 1-4 - the objective overview counts.

momDeltaPoints.description: Month-over-month change in `completionPercent`, in percentage points.

TeachingModuleColumnDTO.description: One column header of the coverage matrix (M01..M10).

TeachingMatrixRowDTO.description:
One row of the "Objective Coverage by Class & Module" matrix.

`modules` is positionally aligned with `TeachingObjectivesDTO.moduleColumns`,
and the string values are exactly the Angular `TeachingModuleStatus` union, so
the matrix component's three-state dot rendering works unmodified.

modules.description: One status per module column, left to right.

teachingMatrix.description: Matrix rows, one per in-scope class section.

ClassParticipationDTO.description:
Aspect 6, card 1 - class participation rate.

Denominator is the in-scope enrolled roll; numerator is distinct students with
at least one COMPLETED `CLASS_PARTICIPATION` activity in the period.

byClass.description: Participation rate per class section, powers the equity score.

ActiveStudentsDTO.description: Aspect 6, card 2 - AI/IVRS + practice active students.

byActivityType.description: Split of the active cohort by activity type, so the UI can label the sources.

sparkline.description: Daily distinct-active counts across the period, for the sparkline.

momPercentChange.description: Month-over-month change, as a percentage of the previous month.

studentsReached.description: Students reached in the period, summed across completed visits.

EngagementMetricsDTO.description:
Aspect 6 payload - `GET /metrics/engagement`.

Also carries the seven-point sparkline arrays the Angular
`EngagementMetricItem.sparkline` component expects, so the cards can be driven
directly from the API.

expectedUtilisationPercent.description:
Straight-line expectation for the elapsed fraction of the academic year.
Lets the UI say "ahead of / behind pace" rather than just showing a raw
percentage, which is otherwise impossible to interpret in April.

hasBudget.description: False when no budget row exists, so the UI can render an empty state.

CategorySpendDTO.description: Aspect 7, card 2 - spend split across the six categories.

percentage.description: Share of total spend, 0-100. Sums to 100 when any spend exists.

allocatedAmount.description: The sanctioned allocation for this category, when a budget is on record.

monthNumber.description: 1-12, for charting against a real date axis.

monthsWithSpend.description: Months that have at least one ledger row, so gaps are visible as gaps.

classProgressPercent.description: The class's mean learning progress %, for comparison against the programme mean.

gapPoints.description: Signed gap in percentage points versus the programme mean.

DerivedInsightsDTO.description:
Three additional calculated metrics that are not part of the seven core
dashboard aspects but are the natural by-product of them.

overallRiskScore.description:
Derived metric #1 - composite Risk Level Score for the whole scope, 0-100
where higher is healthier. Weighted blend of attendance, objective coverage,
learning gain and assessment data completeness.

classEquityScore.description:
Derived metric #2 - Class Equity Score, 0-100 where higher is more equitable.
Computed as 100 minus the Gini coefficient of the per-class learning spread, so
one outlier class measurably drags the programme down.

equityOutliers.description: The classes furthest from the programme mean, for the "equity" drill-down.

learningGainMomDeltaPoints.description:
Derived metric #3 - month-over-month movement of the headline learning gain,
in percentage points, plus an explicit direction so the UI does not have to
infer it from the sign of a string.

dataCompletenessPercent.description: Proportion of in-scope students with at least one assessment, as a data-quality signal.

DashboardSummaryResponseDTO.description:
Unified payload for `GET /metrics/dashboard`.

Deliberately an *interface composition* rather than a type intersection so
that tsoa can resolve every referenced model and emit a correct OpenAPI schema
(tsoa cannot introspect mapped/conditional types).

filter.description: The filter window the figures below were computed over.

teachingObjectives.description: Aspect 5 - teaching objectives and the class x module coverage matrix.

resources.description: Aspect 7 - budget, category split and monthly spend trend.

derivedInsights.description: Aspects 1-3, recomputed across the whole scope rather than per school.

StudentsEnrolledDTO.description:
The five headline cards, itemised.

Each interface below also re-exposes `id`, `value`, `unit`, `subtext` and
`delta` in the same shape the Angular `KpiMetric` card expects, so a single
serialised object can drive either the typed card or the raw KPI ribbon.

delta.description: Growth against the same period one academic year earlier.

weightedPresentDays.description: Weighted present-days over working days across the whole scope.

gainPoints.description: Mean attainment gain in percentage points across assessed students.

strongestDomain.description: Strongest and weakest domains by gain, for the "what moved" callout.

completionPercent.description: Per-objective completion, as shown on the KPI card.

coveragePercent.description: Per-cell class x module coverage, as shown on the matrix summary.

kpiMetrics.description: The same five figures flattened for the KPI ribbon component.

programmeAverage.description: Programme-wide averages, useful for sorting the table against the mean.

bySeverity.description: Alert counts by severity, for the summary chips above the list.

truncatedCount.description: Number of alerts suppressed by the `METRICS_MAX_ALERTS` cap.

post.description:
Bulk upload Daily Attendance from an Excel upload.

Accepts two request shapes, discriminated by `classSectionId`:
 - envelope form  `{ schoolId, classSectionId, records: [...] }`
   the class is named once by primary key
 - code form      `{ records: [{ schoolCode, className, academicYear, ... }] }`
   each row names its class by human-readable code, so one sheet may span
   several classes (this is what the matrix/grid pivot produces)

Both are resolved server-side. `CANCELLED` rows become class-wide records
(studentId = null) and require `remarks`; every other status requires a
`studentId` and is verified against the class's students.

Note: `POST /attendance/batch` is the older numeric-FK endpoint for a single
session and is intentionally left untouched.

get.description:
Get the complete dashboard in one request.

Covers all seven core aspects plus the three derived metrics. Preferred for the
initial page load, because it guarantees every section of the screen is derived
from a single resolved filter window. The granular endpoints expose the same
data for clients that refresh one section at a time.
Get the five headline KPI cards (Aspect 1).

Get learning progress and outcomes (Aspect 2).

Returns overall progress, per-domain baseline vs current, the S1-S5 stage
distribution, stage movement between baseline and current, and the SAS split.
Get the school performance matrix (Aspect 3).
Get the dynamically generated "Needs Attention" alerts (Aspect 4).
Get teaching objectives and the class x module coverage matrix (Aspect 5).
Get stakeholder engagement metrics (Aspect 6).
Get resources and finance tracking (Aspect 7).
